# Atribusi Korpus POS Tagging Bahasa Indonesia

- **Nama dataset:** Indonesian Manually Tagged Corpus (`idn-tagged-corpus`)
- **Penulis:** Ruli Manurung, Arawinda Dinakaramani, Fam Rashel, Andry Luthfi (Fakultas Ilmu Komputer, Universitas Indonesia)
- **Publikasi acuan:** Dinakaramani, A., Rashel, F., Luthfi, A., & Manurung, R. (2014). *Designing an Indonesian part of speech tagset and manually tagged Indonesian corpus*. International Conference on Asian Language Processing (IALP 2014), pp. 66–69.
- **Sumber unduhan:** https://github.com/famrashel/idn-tagged-corpus (`Indonesian_Manually_Tagged_Corpus_ID.tsv`, 10.030 kalimat)
- **Lisensi:** Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/
- **Penggunaan di proyek:** Digunakan sebagai data latih & evaluasi model POS tagger CRF (`python-crfsuite`) untuk modul `src/question_processing/`.
